'''Deripors''' were docile mounts native to [[Ohratuu]]. Former Rebel [[General/Legends|general]] [[Reesen Jivrak]] used them as mounts in hit-and-run attacks, after his [[Science Research Droid]], [[Geth]], injected them with [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] that strengthened and enraged them.
